Compile a complete species report

Source: R/reports.R
sacha_report.Rd

sacha_report() combines taxonomic information, licensed iNaturalist photographs, indexed identifiers, geographic locations, a GBIF map, and bibliographic references in a single Markdown report. Sections are produced in this order: accepted scientific name and authorship, first publication, iNaturalist images, indexed identifiers, common names, taxonomic classification, synonyms and combinations, documented geographic locations, the cropped GBIF map, and bibliographic references.

sacha_report(
  species,
  source = c("local", "web"),
  language = NULL,
  directory = getwd(),
  ...
)

Arguments

species

A scientific name in the form "Genus species".

source

Data source for the iNaturalist image and GBIF map sections. "local" (default) uses previously saved image and occurrence records; "web" queries iNaturalist for images and GBIF for map occurrences. ChecklistBank-backed sections keep their configured web behavior in either mode, including any GBIF or iNaturalist lookups used to resolve indexation links.

language

Optional language code forwarded to accessors that support localized output. NULL follows each module's active language setting.

directory

Common base directory for file-based package functions. GBIF occurrences and maps, iNaturalist images, and saved references use their existing subdirectories under this path. Defaults to the current working directory; it can also be set with sacha_configure().

...

Named arguments forwarded to the relevant underlying functions. Supported names are user_id, number_observations, observation_id, image_size, verify_local, quality_grade, place_id, catalogue_dataset, observer_name, save_images, export_comp, refresh, ncol, word_subfigure_width, latex_subfigure_width, identifier, rank, save_bib, kml, crop_area, crop_box, limit, mode, save_occurrences, export_image, colour, static_legend_position, dpi, overwrite, distribution, fig_width, fig_height, and local_export. Their choices, defaults, and effects are documented by the corresponding accessors inat_images_md(), indexations_md(), classification_md(), references_sp_md(), and gbif_map_crop_md(). The top-level source argument controls the source for both the image and map sections and must not be repeated in ....

Value

In a rendered document, returns one Markdown object containing the combined sections and any figure metadata. In an interactive session, writes the Markdown sections to the console and returns the map result invisibly.

Details

The default source = "local" uses locally available iNaturalist image records and GBIF occurrence data. Before using this default, the relevant local records must have been prepared with the package's save functions, and the crop map must have a configured boundary or a previously saved crop. source controls only the iNaturalist image and GBIF map sections. ChecklistBank-backed taxonomic sections retain their configured web behavior in either mode; the package does not yet read their records from a local ColDP archive. The ChecklistBank adapter may also query GBIF and iNaturalist to resolve taxon identifiers for indexation links. Thus, this report is not fully offline even when source = "local". The save_images, save_occurrences, export_comp, and export_image options can be forwarded to create local outputs while the report is generated.

Online requests are subject to the policies and availability of the respective services. Prefer local data for repeated rendering, request only the records needed, and avoid repeated refreshes or parallel report builds against the same services. Image downloads also consume bandwidth; iNaturalist publishes media-volume and request-rate recommendations in its API practices. These safeguards cannot account for downloads initiated by other processes or users on the same network.

Values may be passed directly to sacha_report() through species, source, language, and the names documented under .... Alternatively, shared arguments can be set beforehand with sacha_arg_configure(); values supplied directly to sacha_report() take precedence.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
sacha_report(species)
} # }
